generation_parents.algorithm: Use a radial-first rule: score each candidate by a weighted mix of closeness to the current node, depot radius continuity, angular sweep consistency around the depot, and capacity-fill preference with retuned weights (higher distance weight, stronger radial penalty, moderate load term).

declared_hypothesis: A different distance/load combination yields better routes.
